tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Poster, portfolio, logbook and slides use the light value; the dashboard defaults to dark.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, chips and alert rows.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and zebra rows: code blocks, table header rows in documents, the hall map floor.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card and table borders, chart gridlines. Decorative only, never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control or a boundary (inputs, quiet buttons, the hall walls on the map). At least 3:1 on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, axis labels, timestamps. On paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The brand color. Title bars on the poster and slides, chapter openers, the logo ink. In dark it is a raised surface for the dashboard header.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a navy fill.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and selected states.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on an action fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: far
tokens.usage: Distance band FAR (2 to 3.5 m, weakest signal). Marks only: arcs, dots, chart bars, map rings. Never body text, never decoration.

tokens.name: mid
tokens.usage: Distance band MID (1 to 2 m). Marks only, as far.

tokens.name: near
tokens.usage: Distance band NEAR (under 1 m, strongest signal). Marks only, as far. Not an error color: a failed test is not near.

tokens.name: far-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a far alert row or the far zone on the hall map; ink text on it.

tokens.name: mid-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a mid alert row or the mid zone on the hall map; ink text on it.

tokens.name: near-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a near alert row or the near zone on the hall map; ink text on it.

tokens.name: clear
tokens.usage: Allowed devices, a unit that is online, a passed requirement. Marks and icons; pair with a word or a check.

tokens.name: clear-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind clear chips and PASS results; ink text on it.

groups.name: Screen
groups.note: Dashboard, slides, web. Headings in Archivo, everything you read in IBM Plex Sans.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Slide titles and the one title on a dashboard screen. One per view.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and panel titles, slide section titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page or slide.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card titles, alert titles, table group labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The unit listens for Bluetooth advertisements and sweeps 126 radio channels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text in dense UI: metadata, helper text, table cells.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Anything measured or machine-made: readings, hashes, times, codes. Mono keeps digits aligned.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: One big result number: accuracy, latency, range. Always with a label and a target.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Readings, hashed addresses, timestamps, channel numbers, commit hashes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, chip text and column labels. Always set in UPPERCASE.

groups.name: Poster
groups.note: The school's landscape poster: 110 x 80 cm sheet, 5 cm margin, 100 x 70 cm design area, written at 1 pt = 1.333 px.

styles.name: poster-title
styles.usage: 81 pt. Project title. Capitals come out about 2 cm tall, inside the guide's 1.5 to 2.5 cm, readable from 2 m.

styles.name: poster-meta
styles.sample: Alexandria STEM School, G.12, Semester 1, 2026-2027, G.No.12323
styles.usage: 60 pt, 26% smaller than the title as the guide asks. The school line and the names.

styles.name: poster-keywords
styles.sample: Keywords: Bluetooth Low Energy, RF Spectrum Sensing
styles.usage: 44 pt. The keywords line under the names.

styles.name: poster-section
styles.usage: 36 pt. Section titles: Abstract, Introduction, Materials and Methods...

styles.name: poster-body
styles.sample: The unit listens passively and never transmits.
styles.usage: 18 pt on 24 pt leading, about 50 lines per column. The smallest body size the guide allows (readable from 1 m). Cut words before you shrink it.

styles.name: poster-caption
styles.usage: 14 pt. Table text, table and figure captions, literature cited.

groups.name: Document
groups.note: A4 portfolio and logbook, written at 1 pt = 1.333 px.

styles.name: doc-chapter
styles.usage: 30 pt. Chapter openers, on a navy band.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: Each session records one device at one distance for three minutes.
styles.usage: 11 pt. Body text, 1.15 line spacing in Word.

spacing.note: A 4 px grid. Poster and documents use the same steps in points.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label; gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related lines; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact rows; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a panel; poster column gutter at screen scale.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins on screen; between major sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Slide margins; space above a chapter title.

radius.note: Small radii: an instrument, not a toy.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, table cells, small marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alert rows, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the dashboard hall map. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots only.
